Bilco Modular is a Perth-based construction company with extensive expertise in delivering major commercial and residential building projects throughout Australia. Our portfolio spans diverse sectors, including mining camp facilities, holiday park developments, and various large-scale construction initiatives.

Position Description: Bilco Group is seeking a qualified Full time wall and floor tiler to work on residential and commercial projects.
Key Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Review and interpret building plans, drawings and specifications, and accurately measure, mark out and set up work areas before work begins.
•	Prepare wall and floor substrates by stripping away old grout, adhesive and other unsuitable materials, rectifying surface defects, and ensuring all surfaces are clean, sound and level ready for tile installation.
•	Apply waterproofing membranes and surface treatments where required.
•	Mix and spread adhesives, cement-based mortars and screeds onto prepared surfaces using the correct methods and techniques.
•	Lay and position tiles with precision, maintaining correct alignment, uniform spacing and a level finish.
•	Cut, shape and fit ceramic, porcelain, terrazzo, glass mosaic and natural stone tiles using hand and power tools, working neatly around edges, corners, fixtures, fittings and pipework.
•	Grout tile joints, then clean and polish completed surfaces to achieve the required finish.
•	Fit tile strips and trim sections to form decorative patterns and produce clean, professional edge detailing.
•	Check finished work against plans, quality expectations and applicable building codes to confirm compliance.
•	Keep the work site clean, safe and well organised at all times.
•	Communicate and coordinate effectively with site supervisors, project managers and other trades on site.

Skills, Qualifications and Experience Required:
•	Certificate III in Wall and Floor Tiling (or equivalent), or at least 3 years' full time relevant experience in lieu of the qualification.
•	At least One years' full time relevant experience, or 3 years' full time relevant experience if no relevant qualification is held.
•	Ability to read and interpret technical drawings
•	Sound knowledge of WHS requirements in construction

At the Sydney Children's Hospitals Network, every role helps children and young people live their healthiest lives.

As the largest paediatric health service in Australia, we care for thousands of children each year, in hospital and at home. Our people are united by compassion, collaboration and excellence in care.

Join a team where your passion for paediatric care truly makes a difference. This state-of-the-art redevelopment will enhance our ability to deliver world-class care to seriously ill and injured children from across NSW and beyond. As part of the Sydney Children's Hospitals Network, our hospital provides a comprehensive range of paediatric and adolescent medical and surgical services, treating children with a variety of complex conditions. 

Located in Sydney's eastern suburbs and co-located with Prince of Wales Hospital and the Royal Hospital for Women, our campus offers easy access to beaches, amenities, and public transport. 

At Sydney Children's Hospital, Randwick, we put children first - always. You'll be part of a warm, supportive environment dedicated to improving the lives of children and their families. 

What you'll be doing
 

The Registered Nurse provides safe, compassionate, person-centred care to patients and families of Sydney Children's Hospital Network. 
The Registered Nurse acts as a role model by demonstrating behaviour and interacting with patients, their families and employees in a way that promotes a culture and standards that reflect the NSW Health CORE values of Collaboration, Openness , Respect and Empowerment.

Salary $180,000 plus commission.
 
In the heart of Newcastle CBD, The Good Dentist Pty LTD is a boutique dental practice seeking a full-time dentist with a minimum of 3 years' clinical experience who is looking for an environment to grow, learn and develop. 
 
We are seeking a clinician with a demonstrated background in delivering high-quality general, restorative and cosmetic dentistry, together with a genuine desire to build a long-term position within our team. 
 
For us, dentistry is more than just a job, it's a lifestyle. We want someone who shares our values of excellence, connection, honesty and care, whilst exhibiting kindness and having fun. 
 
With access to CBCT, iTero digital scanning, rotary endodontic systems, structured clinical processes and strong team support, you will have the ability to concentrate on delivering exceptional dentistry. 

-High-end team and patient expectations 
-Boutique family environment 
-Consistent practice growth and development 
 
Do you crave structure, support, direction and a humble team environment that encourages you to become the best version of yourself and an outstanding clinician? 
 
The successful candidate must have a minimum of 3 years' clinical experience, including at least 2 years practising as a dentist in Australia, relevant tertiary dental qualifications, and current AHPRA registration or eligibility for registration. 
 
If you believe you would add to our collective culture, offer the skill-set to support high end dentistry services, thrive from further education and structure then please send a cover letter, a CV and two written references to garreth@thegooddentist.com.au 
 
We look forward to hearing from you. 

The Good Dentist Team

Position: Plasterer
Type: Full-time
Salary: AUD 68,000/year
Employer: SOLID HOME SOLUTIONS PTY LTD
Location: 101 GAP RD THE GAP NT 0870 AUSTRALIA

About us:

Solid Home Solutions is your go-to expert for residential and commercial maintenance in Alice Springs, NT. Specializing in carpentry, painting, gyprock, fencing, and air-condition installation, we cater to both local and remote communities. Our experienced team is dedicated to providing top-notch service to ensure your property is in top shape.


Position Available:

As a key member of the Solid Home Solutions team, you will work directly alongside our Site Supervisor to deliver high-quality plastering and gyprock services for residential and commercial properties across Alice Springs and remote NT communities. In this role, you’ll be responsible for surface preparation, installing and finishing plasterboard, applying plaster and render, and ensuring all wall and ceiling surfaces are smooth, durable, and finished to our exacting standards—on time and to specification. We value hands-on experience in a fast-paced construction or maintenance environment, particularly where versatility and reliability are key. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an experienced, dedicated crew and make a tangible impact by helping our diverse range of clients keep their properties in top shape.

This is a FULL-TIME position.

Responsibilities:
1. Reading plans and specifications to determine material quantities, panel layouts, and installation methods.
2. Measuring, cutting, and fixing plasterboard sheets to walls and ceilings, including installing insulation and vapour barriers where required.
3. Applying plaster, joint compounds, sealants, and finishing materials to create smooth, even surfaces ready for painting or decoration.
4. Installing corner beads, trims, and decorative features such as cornices, mouldings, and architectural plaster details.
5. Taping and wet-sanding joints and fastener points, then sanding finished areas to a high standard before handover.
6. Inspecting completed work for quality and compliance, while maintaining a clean, safe worksite and following all health and safety procedures.

Requirement:
1. AQF IV plus 1 year relevant full-time experience or 3 years relevant full-time experience.
2. Strong attention to detail and a proven commitment to high-quality craftsmanship.
3. Capable of working independently, managing tasks effectively, and meeting project deadlines.

What We Offer:
1. Attractive salary of AUD 68,000 per year.
2. Excellent opportunities for career growth and professional development.
3. A supportive and collaborative team environment to help you succeed.
